name: Synn
message: 「Yeah~. Still, preparations for the Holy Night Festival are totally ready.」

name: Macaron
message: 「And our special training was super productive!」

name: Synn
message: 「Right. Everyone's gotten pretty strong in such a short time, haven't they.」

name: Macaron
message: 「So much so that even we can't afford to hold back anymore.」

name: Synn
message: 「After all, this is a battle to protect everyone's peace.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mm-hm, you've gotten so reliable too, big brother.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Kyuu-chan. Good work flying in this cold.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yep. Looks like he came all the way across the sea to bring us a letter from Dad and the others.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Of course that's the part you're surprised about...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Agh, never mind! My heart's pounding too hard, I can't touch it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gyaaah!? That's cold! Don't put your hands down my back!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, that stuff doesn't even matter.」
In the end, I break the seal right in front of Macaron.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, it's a Christmas card. There's a photo inside too.」

name: Synn
message: 「...So, what do you think after seeing his face for the first time in forever.」

name: Macaron
message: 「But it feels like he's gotten way more distinguished.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Your mom looks really pretty and kind too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Dad's totally head over heels for her, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mom and Dad said they're doing well.」

name: Synn
message: 「Also, they said it's a little early, but Merry Christmas.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I see... Well, knowing Master, they'll probably be fine wherever they go.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm a little jealous of you, Big Brother...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I mean... your mom and dad genuinely care about you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even when you're apart, they're still watching over you properly like this.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Having a family who holds you dear makes me jealous...」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't you have a mom and dad too, Macaron, if you go back to the Demon World?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I told you before, didn't I? Papa and Mama don't care about me at all.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Papa and Mama only want to use me whenever it's convenient for them.」

name: Macaron
message: 「They obviously don't care how I feel at all...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Did your mom and dad actually say that?」

name: Macaron
message: 「They forced studying and lessons on me... I never got to be spoiled...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even when we were together, it never made me happy...」

name: Synn
message: 「Once Re-Crea is over, let's go to the Demon World together.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then we'll meet your mom and dad and have a proper talk with them.」

name: Synn
message: 「We'll ask how they really feel about you...」

name: Synn
message: 「And tell them how you truly feel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Running away without even checking properly isn't like you at all, Macaron.」

name: Synn
message: 「The Macaron I know wouldn't do something like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, if you're going to be a great Demon Lord, you need to get along with your parents too.」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be okay. No matter what happens, I'm right here with you.」

name: Synn
message: 「I just can't stand seeing you look so down, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Leaving my worries unresolved just isn't like me at all.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Once Re-Crea is settled, I'm going to the Demon World with you, Big Brother.」

name: Macaron
message: 「And then, I'll show Mom and Dad just how amazing I've become!」

name: Macaron
message: 「With you there with me, I feel like I can face them properly...」

name: Macaron
message: 「And I think I'll be able to smile honestly.」

name: Synn
message: 「With the two of us, there's nothing to worry about.」

name: Synn
message: 「While we're at it, I'll pay my respects too.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? Wait, were you serious about that...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph! I was just pumping you up!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If we can't do something about tomorrow's Re-Crea, we won't have time to talk like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, Macaron! Give me one more, a really hard one!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I do it that hard, Big Brother might end up breaking...」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks to Macaron, I'm totally pumped! Nothing to be scared of tomorrow!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Pump me up too! I'm not gonna let big bro hog all the spotlight!」
You want me to whack Macaron?
Those slender shoulders... look too fragile to lay a hand on.
That small, toned tummy... is totally out of the picture visually.
And that chest with barely any padding... if the shock stopped a heart, it'd be a disaster. Mine, that is.

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right, let's switch methods here and try using qigong.」

name: Synn
message: 「By pressing my hand against you, I'll gradually infuse you with fighting spirit...」
Driven by an urge I can't shake off, I slowly reach out my hand.

name: Synn
message: 「T-This is just how the breathing technique goes.」
Closing the distance with Macaron even further...
And thus, my palm touches down onto Macaron's head.
Aah, what am I even doing. Am I a pervert? Yeah, I am.

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah, that last one didn't have enough momentum.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Listen, you can pat my head whenever you want, okay...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, hit me with your best shot!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll be fine! As long as I think of it as Big Brother's love!」
I feel like I'm gonna get a nosebleed even though nobody hit me.

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm really gonna do it, okay~? I'm gonna mess you right up~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Something like that is no big deal!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi. You shared your fighting spirit with me, Big Brother♪」

name: Synn
message: 「...Do you think you'll be okay for tomorrow?」

name: Macaron
message: 「As long as I'm with you, Big Brother.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「...Me too, as long as I'm with Macaron.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's definitely make both the Holy Night Festival and the battle against Re-Crea a success...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, maybe this really is the best way to get fired up...」
I'll protect this world, and everyone's peace.
Is this irreplaceable person, who stays right by my side.
Because to me, she is what matters most.
